A '''function sequence''' is a [[sequence]] of [[function]]s.

== Formal definition ==

Let $S=\{f_i(D)\}$ be a [[set]] of [[function]]s with the same [[function#Formal_definition|domain]] $D$.

Any function

$$
A: \mathbb{N} \to S
$$

is a '''function sequence'''.

{{Hidden example}}
if

$$
\forall n \in \mathbb{N}, \forall x \in \mathbb{R}: f_n(x)=x^n
$$

then $(f_n)$ is a function sequence.
{{End hidden}}
